note: Extra top-level fields added to a gateway's Responses requests. A request rejection that names a field disables the fields for that provider scope and retries once without them.

gateways.note: Session cache: each round updates the cache and the next round continues from its previous_response_id. The coding/agent plan endpoints (/api/coding/v3) reject caching and do not store responses. Caching may require account enablement and is billed by stored tokens.
